CAUTION
To prevent damage to scan tool MB991502, always turn the 
ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position before 
connecting or disconnecting scan tool MB991502.
1. Connect scan tool MB991502 to the data link connector.
2. Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
3. Use scan tool MB991502 to check for auto-cruise control 
system diagnostic trouble codes.
4. Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
5. Disconnect scan tool MB991502.
Using a Auto-cruise Control Indicator Light
1. Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position while holding the 
auto-cruise control switch in the "SET" position (down). 
Then, within one second, more the cruise control switch up 
to the "RES" position.
2. Read a diagnostic trouble code by observing the flash 
display pattern of the auto-cruise control indicator light in the 
combination meter.
